The mention starts in [MentionTextarea](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/b9a97519-a439-43fb-a456-fffac57b84bb/src/components/domain/comment/mention-textarea.tsx). On each edit, its `emit` function calls `resolveMentions(body, members)` and reports both the body and resolved user IDs to [CommentComposer](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/b9a97519-a439-43fb-a456-fffac57b84bb/src/components/domain/comment/comment-composer.tsx). The composer submits those IDs as `mentionedUserIds` alongside the comment body.

In [mentions.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/b9a97519-a439-43fb-a456-fffac57b84bb/src/lib/mentions.ts), `extractMentions` finds distinct handles case-insensitively, ignoring email addresses and mentions inside code spans or fenced blocks. `handleOf` defines a member’s handle as the lowercased local part of their email address, and `resolveMentions` maps matching handles to member user IDs. Unknown handles are dropped.

On submission, `createCommentAction` in [create-comment.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/b9a97519-a439-43fb-a456-fffac57b84bb/src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts) validates and authorizes the request, applies rate limiting, and calls `createComment` in [comment-service.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/b9a97519-a439-43fb-a456-fffac57b84bb/src/server/services/comment-service.ts). The service checks the organization and issue, then `resolveMentionedUsers` looks up up to 100 organization members and resolves the body again. It combines those IDs with client-provided IDs that occur in that member list, removing duplicates. Thus the list can include a known client-provided ID even if it is no longer in the body.

`createComment` passes that list to `insertComment` in [comment-repository.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/b9a97519-a439-43fb-a456-fffac57b84bb/src/server/repositories/comment-repository.ts), which stores it as JSON on the comment. It then emits `comment.created` with the same `mentionedUserIds`, issue ID, comment ID, and actor information. The typed event payload is defined in [event.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/b9a97519-a439-43fb-a456-fffac57b84bb/src/types/event.ts). Server startup loads [event-registry.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/b9a97519-a439-43fb-a456-fffac57b84bb/src/server/services/event-registry.ts), which imports the notification service and registers its subscriber. `emit` in [event-bus.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/b9a97519-a439-43fb-a456-fffac57b84bb/src/lib/event-bus.ts) waits for subscribers to settle, but does not rethrow their failures, so a successful comment does not guarantee successful notification fan-out.

The `comment.created` subscriber in [notification-service.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/b9a97519-a439-43fb-a456-fffac57b84bb/src/server/services/notification-service.ts) first notifies the issue author and assignee of the new comment, then calls `notify` with kind `comment_mention` and the event’s mentioned IDs. `notify` deduplicates recipients, skips the actor, loads each recipient’s preference for that kind, and calls `resolveChannels`:

- With no saved preference, the channels are `in_app` and `email`.
- With a preference, `in_app` follows `inApp`. `email` is included when `email` is true and either `digestOnly` is false or the organization’s `digest_email` flag is enabled.
- If neither channel remains, no notification row is inserted.

`insertNotifications` in [notification-repository.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/b9a97519-a439-43fb-a456-fffac57b84bb/src/server/repositories/notification-repository.ts) stores one unread row per remaining recipient, including its channel list. The [inbox page](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/b9a97519-a439-43fb-a456-fffac57b84bb/src/app/(dashboard)/%5BorgSlug%5D/inbox/page.tsx) calls `listNotifications`, which reads rows by organization and recipient without filtering on channels. Consequently, even an email-only row appears in the inbox.

The channel names describe intended delivery, but this path does **not** send an immediate mention email: `notify` only inserts rows. The later digest path in [digest-service.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/b9a97519-a439-43fb-a456-fffac57b84bb/src/server/services/digest-service.ts) and [digest-email-job.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/b9a97519-a439-43fb-a456-fffac57b84bb/src/server/jobs/digest-email-job.ts) can include unread rows for digest subscribers when the flag and time window permit; it does not filter those rows by channel or kind. Its `sendEmail` function in [email-service.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/b9a97519-a439-43fb-a456-fffac57b84bb/src/server/services/email-service.ts) logs the message rather than delivering mail over a network.
